messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: itemfit when response is polytomous
parts:
There is a problem when using itemfit when response is polytomous. Here I use the example in itemfit section in the manual. I found this problem when fit to my empirical dataset. Is it a bug? Thanks.

set.seed(1234)
a <- matrix(rlnorm(20, meanlog=0, sdlog = .1),ncol=1)
d <- matrix(rnorm(20),ncol=1)
items <- rep('dich', 20)
data <- simdata(a,d, 2000, items)
data[2,3:6] = NA
raschfit <- mirt(data, 1, itemtype='Rasch')
Theta <- fscores(raschfit, method = 'ML', full.scores=TRUE)
itemfit(raschfit, impute = 10, Theta=Theta)

# but there is a problem when polytomous data

data[3,2] = 2 # randomly fake response as polytomous

raschfit <- mirt(data, 1, itemtype='Rasch')
Theta <- fscores(raschfit, method = 'ML', full.scores=TRUE)
itemfit(raschfit, impute = 10, Theta=Theta)

Error in UpdatePrepList(PrepList, pars, random = mixed.design$random,  :
  Rows in supplied and starting value data.frame objects do not match. Were the
             data or itemtype input arguments modified?

There is a problem when using itemfit when response is polytomous. Here I use the example in itemfit section in the manual. I found this problem when fit to my empirical dataset. Is it a bug? Thanks.

set.seed(1234)
a <- matrix(rlnorm(20, meanlog=0, sdlog = .1),ncol=1)
d <- matrix(rnorm(20),ncol=1)
items <- rep('dich', 20)
data <- simdata(a,d, 2000, items)
data[2,3:6] = NA
raschfit <- mirt(data, 1, itemtype='Rasch')
Theta <- fscores(raschfit, method = 'ML', full.scores=TRUE)
itemfit(raschfit, impute = 10, Theta=Theta)

data[3,2] = 2 # randomly fake response as polytomous
